verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a SaaS email API. The only evidence of readable source is the companion tooling hosted on GitHub: the MCP server repo (resend/resend-mcp) and the official CLI (resend/resend-cli). Nothing shows the core email service's source is public, and no license terms are cited for any repository. Missing for 10: evidence that the core Resend service source is available, an explicitly stated open-source license (e.g. MIT or Apache) for any repo, and independent confirmation of open-source status.
